source_dataset: LeRobot v3; train/ and validation/ split by collection session
state_layout: q[7] radians + measured Robotiq aperture/2 twice in metres
stage1_requirement: SFT pi0.5 and train RL-token module; ordinary pi05_droid checkpoint is not sufficient
status: RLinf Stage-1 entry integrated; CPU data/model/two-rank FSDP tests passed; full CUDA training pending
normalization_method: quantile_q01_q99 with epsilon 1e-6; no silent clipping

learning_mode: offline supervised Stage-1: pi0.5 actions + RL-token auxiliary objective
